Os preços das impressoras e peças do cat: Are the catalog's printer and part prices exact?
São estimativas de mercado pra você come: They're market estimates so you can start quickly. Adjust them with your own values in Settings — that's what makes the calculation match your reality.
O estoque desconta sozinho?: Does stock deduct on its own?
Só dos materiais em que você informar o: Only for materials where you enter a stock amount, and only on quotes issued as PDF. When you mark the order as "In production", the amount used comes out of stock, along with the loss estimated from the calculation's waste. If you go back in status, it returns. Afterwards you adjust the "actual loss" to what was really lost to failed prints and supports. Materials without a stock amount aren't tracked, and the low-stock warning stays off until you turn it on.
O lucro do resumo do mês é o lucro de ve: Is the monthly summary profit the real profit?
É o preço que você cobrou menos o custo: It's the price you charged minus the cost the app calculated when you issued the quote, summed over the orders approved that month. If you enter the actual cost of miscellaneous items (key rings, clasps, glue…), it replaces the calculation's estimate. The profit doesn't subtract marketplace fees or expenses outside the calculation, such as shipping and rent. It's for tracking each order's margin, not for replacing your accounting.

Qual a diferença entre margem e markup?: What's the difference between margin and markup?
Margem é a fatia do preço final que sobr: Margin is the share of the final price that remains as profit: with a 40% margin, $40 of every $100 sold is profit. Markup is how much you add on top of cost, and it yields less profit than it seems. Precifica 3D uses true margin.
